extensions.documentationMethod: Source-based record of the user-requested independent redesign. No installed design skill was used. This file is descriptive metadata, not an active workflow.

display.purpose: Bold Manrope hero and section headings.

tagline.purpose: Bodoni Moda italic for the hero tagline.

quote.purpose: Bodoni Moda 500, regular style, for the attributed quote.

body.purpose: Manrope for reading, navigation, labels and controls.

shadows.name: mobile-lesson-action
shadows.purpose: Separates the floating mobile action from the page.

motion.name: interaction
motion.purpose: Button arrows, colors and media hints; disabled for reduced motion.

inquiryFormStatus.privacy: Only an activated opaque endpoint is configured. The receiving address remains private and absent from public source, HTML, documentation and URLs.
inquiryFormStatus.validation: Verification and production inbox receipt are separate from this design record.

components.name: Primary lesson action
components.description: White text on terracotta, 55px minimum height, 5px corners. Targets #contact.

components.name: Lesson row
components.description: A full-width linked row separated by fine warm-gray rules, with a circular arrow. Preselects form interest.

components.name: Performance frame
components.description: Contained black frame with authentic video. Attempts sound and falls back to muted autoplay; reduced motion begins with the poster.

components.name: Sound control
components.description: 44px circular speaker, white on near-black #171715, with an accessible name and tooltip. An image-sized button separately controls pause/resume.

components.name: Teacher panel
components.description: Conceptual guitar image paired with the teacher introduction and attributed student quote.

components.name: Practice panel
components.description: Compact beige inset with explanatory copy and a separate guitar-and-chair mood image.

components.name: FAQ row
components.description: Native details and summary, divided by fine rules with a rotating plus icon.

components.name: Lesson inquiry form
components.description: Light panel within dark contact section. Required name/email; optional phone, interest and message. White fields and full-width terracotta submit. Mobile places route information after the form.

components.name: Mobile lesson action
components.description: Floating terracotta contact link, hidden while the primary hero action or contact section is visible.

narrative.overview: Ivory surroundings, strong ink typography and terracotta invitations place authentic playing at the center. A contained black performance frame balances the clear lesson offer. Linked lesson rows, a teacher panel with its quote, compact practice imagery and a light form on dark ink complete the path to an inquiry.
keyCharacteristics: Bold Manrope headings and wordmark with a retained six-string H.
Bodoni Moda only for the italic hero tagline and student quote.
Authentic performance, distinct conceptual supporting imagery and traceable business claims.
Responsive reading order and one clear inquiry destination.

rules.name: Color hierarchy
rules.body: Use ivory for the main page, ink for text and the final contact section, and terracotta for invitations.

rules.name: Typography hierarchy
rules.body: Manrope carries headings and reading; Bodoni adds limited expression in the hero tagline and quote.

rules.name: Responsive contact
rules.body: Keep the form before route information on mobile and hide the floating action while an existing primary destination is visible.

dos: Preserve the approved headline and free introductory lesson offer.
Preserve source provenance, quote attribution and business facts.
Keep visible focus, reduced-motion behavior and manual playback choices.
Keep the recipient private and all primary invitations directed to #contact.
donts: Do not describe conceptual images as Hamlet teaching or his actual studio.
Do not invent prices, availability, credentials or outcomes.
Do not treat submitted requests as confirmed lessons or guaranteed inbox delivery.
